tooltip.simpleradio_repeaters.bank: Plug into the top of a Relay attached to an antenna to allow inserted channels to be repeated.
tooltip.simpleradio_repeaters.card: Tune in a radiosmithing station, then right-click a Repeater Bank to insert.
tooltip.simpleradio_repeaters.transponde: Plug into a Relay. Left card to right cards; click the display to toggle simplex/duplex.
tooltip.simpleradio_repeaters.nether_foc: Attach to an overworld Relay to project a weak signal into the Nether. Attach to a Nether relay to improve signal reliability and reach.
tooltip.simpleradio_repeaters.end_focus: Attach to an overworld Relay to project a decent signal into the End, and vice versa.
tooltip.simpleradio_repeaters.amplifier: Attach to a Relay to amplify the attached Antenna power, and any signals passing through.
